script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are pinning your name to a private door. As a Fire sign ruled by Mars, Venus in Scorpio in your 8th House forms a flowing trine to Mars in Pisces in your 12th House, stirring hidden desire and secret support. Meanwhile Saturn, ruler of your 10th House of career, sits at zero degrees Aries in your 1st House, one day from stationing direct. For money, a stalled contract or promotion tied to Saturn's 10th House finally unlocks, but do not sign until the station passes. This is not the moment for impulsive spending. Avoid gossip behind closed doors; an older mentor may quietly hand you the key. Pay attention after sunset. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
